from pysat.solvers import Glucose3
from itertools import combinations

n = 22
solver = Glucose3()

def var(i, j):
    if i > j:
        i, j = j, i
    return i * n - i * (i + 1) // 2 + j - i

for c in combinations(range(n), 5):
    solver.add_clause([-var(i, j) for i, j in combinations(c, 2)])
    solver.add_clause([var(i, j) for i, j in combinations(c, 2)])

if solver.solve():
    model = solver.get_model()
    colors = [0 if x > 0 else 1 for x in model[:n*(n-1)//2]]
    print("SAT")
    print(colors)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
